name: Walton Non-Frost Inverter Refrigerator (347L)
description: 347-liter non-frost inverter refrigerator featuring eco-friendly R600a refrigerant and a 5-star energy efficiency rating. Advanced compressor technology delivers maximum cooling with low electricity bills. Designed with a wide operating voltage range of 85V–300V that requires no external voltage stabilizer during power fluctuations. Backed by a 12-year compressor guarantee.
